action.objective: Develop the b1 knight to c3, controlling d5/e4 and preparing kingside development and castling.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search over all 20 legal moves found b1c3 among the top candidates (score 52), and single-candidate verification at depth 4 was exact (score 0, bound=exact) with a clean PV b1c3 b8c6 g1f3 g8f6. Safety check confirmed no immediate Black mate-in-one and no tactical refutation (status not_found). The move is commit_ready. It develops a minor, adds central control of d5/e4, and keeps the position sound without exposing the king; no material or structural concessions are involved.
